name: XHTheme AI Toolbox
author: xhtheme

sections.description:
XHTheme AI Toolbox is a powerful WordPress plugin designed for content creators, integrating advanced AI language models including DeepSeek and others. This plugin enables content generation, paragraph optimization, auto comments, tag extraction, summary generation, auto slugs, and category assignment to significantly improve content creation efficiency and quality.

Key Features

AI Content Generation/Optimization

  • Generate or optimize paragraph content using AI models
  • Support undo and model switching

AI Auto Comments

  • Intelligently analyze post content to generate relevant comments
  • Configurable comment quantity and randomized scheduling
  • Probability to generate comment replies (for comments >10)
  • May include emojis with certain probability

AI Tag Extraction

  • Automatically extract relevant tags from post content
  • New tags can automatically generate English aliases and descriptions

AI Summary Generation

  • One-click post summary generation
  • Customizable summary length and frontend style

Metadata Completion

  • Automatically complete post metadata for better SEO
  • Includes post slug generation and auto category selection
  • Topic expansion feature coming in next version

API Usage Limits

Some API interfaces require payment, please refer to the pricing policy on the APPID acquisition page.

User Guide

AI Paragraph Feature

  1. Select or create a paragraph block when editing post
  2. Click the AI icon in toolbar
  3. Choose “Generate Content” or “Optimize Content”
  4. Wait for AI processing
  5. Click “Regenerate” if modification needed
  6. Click “Undo” to revert if unsatisfied

Other AI Features

  1. Complete feature configuration in plugin settings
  2. Click the AI button when publishing to trigger services
  3. AI will analyze content and generate data based on settings
  4. Review and confirm whether to apply the results

External Services

This plugin connects to XHTheme AI API (https://www.xhtheme.com) for AI-powered content optimization:

  1. Service purposes:

    • Paragraph generation/optimization
    • Post summary generation
    • Tag extraction/management

  2. Data transmission:

    • Only sends content when explicitly triggered by user
    • No personal data collection/transmission
    • Real-time processing without permanent external storage

  3. Service provider:

    • Provided by XHTheme
    • Terms: https://www.xhtheme.com/agreement/
    • Privacy: https://www.xhtheme.com/privacy-policy/

An API key (APPID) is required to access these services, available at XHTheme website.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the xhtheme-ai-toolbox folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through WordPress admin panel
  3. Go to “Settings > XHTheme AI Toolbox” to configure options
  4. Start using AI features to enhance your content workflow
sections.faq:
Does the plugin require an API key?

Yes, an API key is required as it needs to call AI model interfaces for content generation.

How to use the AI paragraph feature?

When editing a post, select a paragraph block and click the AI icon in the toolbar to generate or optimize content.

How does AI auto comment work?

When publishing a post, the plugin analyzes content and generates preview comments first. Remaining comments are processed in background queue and published randomly within configured timeframe for natural-looking discussion.

How to renew after exhausting resource package?

You can check balance and purchase new resource packages on the API provider’s page.

Does the plugin support multilingual?

Yes, the plugin supports multiple languages with good compatibility for English and Chinese.
